## Post purchase, NPS & attribution surveys you can query with your own AI. Unlimited responses. 

 Grapevine is a Shopify-native survey platform. Run post purchase, NPS, CSAT, attribution and on-site surveys from one app, with unlimited responses on every plan, so collecting more never costs more. Attribution reporting ties responses to order and AOV data so you can see which channels drive sales. Display rules target surveys by order value, product, country and customer type. Send responses to Klaviyo, Shopify Flow and GA4, or query them with your own AI assistant via our MCP integration.
